method: Round 1 exploratory. Round 2 drains warmup and observes durable ACKs through read-only sender SQLite every 100ms. Both use 16 sequential API broadcasts and 8 broadcasts at concurrency 4, 256-byte payload, real release daemons with 2 Tokio workers each. No models. Round 3 confirms the final shipping local Release artifact with the refined method. Background host memory varied, recorded in samples; no claim of isolated dedicated hardware.

report.scope: One Windows host, real independent release Rust daemons, direct-only iroh; no models, no WAN/relay capacity inference

definitions.latency: Local authenticated IPC groups.send wall time, including authorization and all initial fanout attempts; allAckLatency includes only broadcasts where every recipient ACKed immediately
definitions.deliveryRate: Recipient SQLite histories independently read after up to 45s drain; sender local copy excluded; failed send intents remain in denominator
definitions.memory: Sum native process private committed bytes plus sum working sets; summed working sets may double-count shared pages; harness memory separate
